summary: This video breaks down top-performing China server team compositions and strategies for Phase 1 of the Season 8 Endboss, Mekkatorque (Tol of Gears). Phase 1 is a pure damage race with minimal survival checks, where maintaining proper skill rotation speed and stats like Accuracy or Resistance is key. High-performing comps include Radiance Heavy-DMG (pushing past 2.2B), Necrosis Shadow (over 2B), Poison Corrosion/Toxin, and Lightning Dauntless. Gear builds, positioning, and skill timings for each elemental affinity are outlined so players can prepare before the boss releases globally.

Necrosis Shadow comp reaching over 2B damage with fast skill cycling and defense stripping.

meta_changes: Mekkatorque Phase 1 is strictly a DPS race with negligible survival pressure.
Debuff-focused teams scale extremely well due to the boss's Misfire passive amplifying incoming debuffs.
tips: Keep skill rotations clean so Mekkatorque cannot scramble your cast order.
Build high Resistance (to prevent cast order scramble) or over 200 Accuracy (to overcome boss accuracy debuffs) based on team type.
Frontload damage before 12 seconds to maximize the Emergency Calibration burst window.
Position your tank carefully to mitigate damage fall-off from the boss's left-to-right sweep attack.
